name: Senior Analyst
description: Handles document OCR and financial analysis through the SecureLend MCP service, registering its own machine-to-machine credentials before it can read anything. Setup depends on that external endpoint being reachable, so it is unusable without access to the SecureLend system.

official.title: Senior Analyst by T
official.description: Turns uploaded invoices and financial statements into structured JSON and Excel. Native-text PDFs skip cloud vision; scans are classified then extracted.
